<script>
document.getElementById('facilitySearch').addEventListener('input', function() {
  const s = this.value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('#facilitySelect option').forEach(o => {
    o.style.display = o.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(s) ? '' : 'none';
  });
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const typeSelect  = document.getElementById('facility-type');
  if (!typeSelect) return;
  const parentField = document.getElementById('parent-facility-field');
  const parentSel   = parentField ? parentField.querySelector('select[name="parent_id"]') : null;

  const toggle = () => {
    const isSat = typeSelect.value === 'satellite';
    if (parentField) parentField.style.display = isSat ? 'flex' : 'none';
    if (parentSel) {
      isSat ? parentSel.setAttribute('required','required') : parentSel.removeAttribute('required');
    }
  };
  typeSelect.addEventListener('change', toggle);
  toggle();
});
</script>

<script>
var _csrf   = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _id     = <%= reimb.reimb_id %>;
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';

function apiPost(url, body) {
  return fetch(url + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
  }).then(function(r) { return r.json(); });
}

function doAction(action, notes, reason) {
  var msgs = {
    submit:  _locale==='fr'?'Soumettre au Directeur ?':'Submit to Director?',
    approve: _locale==='fr'?'Approuver cette demande ?':'Approve this request?',
    cancel:  _locale==='fr'?'Annuler cette demande ?':'Cancel this request?',
  };
  if (!confirm(msgs[action] || 'Confirm?')) return;
  apiPost('/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '/' + action,
    { notes: notes, reason: reason })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) {
        window.location.href = '/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '?success=' + action;
      } else { alert(d.error || 'Error'); }
    });
}

function promptReject() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale==='fr'?'Motif du rejet (obligatoire):':'Rejection reason (required):');
  if (!reason || !reason.trim()) return;
  apiPost('/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '/reject', { reason: reason.trim() })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) { window.location.href = '/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '?success=rejected'; }
      else { alert(d.error || 'Error'); }
    });
}

function doPay() {
  var method = document.getElementById('pay_method').value;
  var ref    = document.getElementById('pay_ref').value;
  var notes  = document.getElementById('pay_notes').value;
  if (!method) {
    alert(_locale==='fr'?'Choisissez un mode de paiement.':'Select a payment method.');
    return;
  }
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Confirmer le paiement ?':'Confirm payment?')) return;
  apiPost('/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '/pay',
    { payment_method: method, payment_reference: ref, notes: notes })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) { window.location.href = '/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '?success=paid'; }
      else { alert(d.error || 'Error'); }
    });
}

function uploadReceipt(input) {
  if (!input.files[0]) return;
  var fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('receipt', input.files[0]);
  fd.append('_csrf', _csrf);
  fetch('/finances/reimbursements/' + _id + '/receipt?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), { method: 'POST', body: fd })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) { window.location.reload(); }
      else { alert(d.error || 'Upload failed'); }
    });
}
</script>

<script>
function toggleType() {
  var isPo = document.getElementById('type_po').checked;
  document.getElementById('po_section').style.display     = isPo ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('direct_section').style.display = isPo ? 'none' : '';
  if (!isPo) document.getElementById('po_id').value = '';
}

function prefillAmount() {
  var sel = document.getElementById('po_id');
  var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  if (opt && opt.dataset.amount) {
    document.getElementById('amount_field').value = opt.dataset.amount;
  }
}

function previewFiles(fileList) {
  var container = document.getElementById('previewContainer');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  Array.from(fileList).slice(0, 5).forEach(function(file) {
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = e.target.result;
      img.className = 'preview-img';
      img.title = file.name;
      img.onclick = function() { window.open(e.target.result); };
      container.appendChild(img);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

var dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); this.classList.add('drag-over'); });
dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { this.classList.remove('drag-over'); });
dropZone.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault(); this.classList.remove('drag-over');
  var input = document.getElementById('receiptInput');
  input.files = e.dataTransfer.files;
  previewFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
});

// Pre-fill if PO was passed
<% if (prefilledPo) { %>
  prefillAmount();
<% } %>
</script>

                                else if (nl.includes('erreur') || nl.includes('error') ||
                                         nl.includes('failed'))                                bc = 'bg-danger';

<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-submenu > a').forEach(function (element) {
    element.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      let submenu = this.nextElementSibling;
      if (submenu) {
        submenu.classList.toggle('show');
        this.parentNode.classList.toggle('show');
      }
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
var hasInsurance = false;

function toggleInsurance(checked) {
  hasInsurance = checked;
  document.getElementById('insurance-section').style.display    = checked ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('no-insurance-section').style.display = checked ? 'none'  : 'block';
  updatePrice();
}

function setInsuranceName(sel) {
  var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  document.getElementById('insurance_firm_name').value = opt ? (opt.getAttribute('data-name') || '') : '';
  updatePrice();
}

function updatePrice() {
  var sel   = document.getElementById('consultation_id');
  var opt   = sel ? sel.options[sel.selectedIndex] : null;
  if (!opt || !opt.value) {
    document.getElementById('price-display').textContent = '—';
    document.getElementById('computed_price').value = '';
    document.getElementById('patient_share').textContent = '—';
    return;
  }
  var p1 = parseFloat(opt.getAttribute('data-price'))     || 0;
  var p2 = parseFloat(opt.getAttribute('data-price-ins')) || 0;
  var price = hasInsurance ? p2 : p1;

  document.getElementById('price-display').textContent  = price.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('computed_price').value       = price;

  if (hasInsurance) {
    var pctEl  = document.getElementById('insurance_pct');
    var pct    = pctEl ? (parseFloat(pctEl.value) || 0) : 0;
    var patAmt = Math.round(price * (1 - pct / 100));
    document.getElementById('patient_share').textContent = patAmt.toLocaleString();
  } else {
    document.getElementById('patient_share').textContent = '—';
  }
}

// Prevent double-submit
document.getElementById('admitForm').addEventListener('submit', function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnAdmit');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>'
    + ('<%= locale==="fr"?"Traitement...":"Processing..." %>');
});
</script>

<script>
// Photo preview
document.getElementById('photo').addEventListener('change', function() {
  if (this.files[0]) {
    var preview = document.getElementById('photoPreview');
    preview.src = URL.createObjectURL(this.files[0]);
    preview.style.display = 'block';
  }
});

// Review button — validate then show modal
document.getElementById('btnReview').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var nameL = document.getElementById('name_last').value.trim();
  var nameF = document.getElementById('name_first').value.trim();
  var dob   = document.getElementById('date_birth').value;
  var nat   = document.getElementById('citizenship').value;
  var isFr  = '<%= locale %>' === 'fr';

  var missing = [];
  if (!nameL) missing.push(isFr ? 'Nom' : 'Last name');
  if (!nameF) missing.push(isFr ? 'Prénom' : 'First name');
  if (!dob)   missing.push(isFr ? 'Date de naissance' : 'Date of birth');
  if (!nat)   missing.push(isFr ? 'Nationalité' : 'Nationality');

  if (missing.length) {
    alert((isFr ? 'Champs obligatoires : ' : 'Required fields: ') + missing.join(', '));
    return;
  }

  var sex    = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_r"]:checked').value;
  var bg     = document.querySelector('input[name="bg_r"]:checked').value;
  var rh     = document.querySelector('input[name="rh_r"]:checked').value;
  var civil  = document.getElementById('civil_status');
  var rel    = document.getElementById('contact_relation');
  var dobFmt = new Date(dob + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString(isFr ? 'fr-FR' : 'en-GB');

  var rows = [
    [isFr ? 'Nom'             : 'Last Name',      nameL],
    [isFr ? 'Prénom(s)'       : 'First Name',     nameF],
    [isFr ? 'Nom jeune fille' : 'Maiden Name',    document.getElementById('name_maiden').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Date naissance'  : 'Date of Birth',  dobFmt],
    [isFr ? 'Sexe'            : 'Sex',            sex === 'm' ? (isFr ? 'Masculin' : 'Male') : (isFr ? 'Féminin' : 'Female')],
    [isFr ? 'Nationalité'     : 'Nationality',    nat],
    [isFr ? 'Groupe sanguin'  : 'Blood Group',    bg + rh],
    [isFr ? 'État civil'      : 'Civil Status',   civil.options[civil.selectedIndex].text],
    [isFr ? 'Profession'      : 'Profession',     document.getElementById('profession').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Religion'        : 'Religion',       document.getElementById('religion').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Tribu / Origine'  : 'Tribe / Ethnic Origin',
      (function() {
        var el = document.getElementById('ethnic_orig');
        return el && el.selectedIndex > 0 ? el.options[el.selectedIndex].text : '—';
      }())
    ],
    [isFr ? 'Téléphone 1'     : 'Phone 1',        document.getElementById('cellphone_1_nr').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Téléphone 2'     : 'Phone 2',        document.getElementById('cellphone_2_nr').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Email'           : 'Email',          document.getElementById('email').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Adresse'         : 'Address',        document.getElementById('addr_str').value || '—'],
    [isFr ? 'Contact urgence' : 'Emergency',
      document.getElementById('contact_person').value
        ? document.getElementById('contact_person').value
          + (rel.value ? ' (' + rel.options[rel.selectedIndex].text + ')' : '')
          + (document.getElementById('relative_phone').value ? ' — ' + document.getElementById('relative_phone').value : '')
        : '—'
    ],
  ];

  var html = '<div class="row g-0">';
  rows.forEach(function(pair) {
    html += '<div class="col-md-6 d-flex border-bottom py-1 px-2">'
      + '<span class="text-muted me-2" style="min-width:110px;font-size:0.72rem;">' + pair[0] + '</span>'
      + '<strong style="font-size:0.8rem;">' + pair[1] + '</strong></div>';
  });
  html += '</div>';

  document.getElementById('confirmBody').innerHTML = html;
  new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('confirmModal')).show();
});

// Confirm — copy all visible values into hidden inputs, then submit form
document.getElementById('btnConfirm').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var map = {
    'h_name_last':        'name_last',
    'h_name_first':       'name_first',
    'h_name_maiden':      'name_maiden',
    'h_date_birth':       'date_birth',
    'h_nat_id_nr':        'nat_id_nr',
    'h_profession':       'profession',
    'h_religion':         'religion',
    'h_ethnic_orig':      'ethnic_orig',
    'h_email':            'email',
    'h_addr_str':         'addr_str',
    'h_addr_zip':         'addr_zip',
    'h_cellphone_1_nr':   'cellphone_1_nr',
    'h_cellphone_2_nr':   'cellphone_2_nr',
    'h_contact_person':   'contact_person',
    'h_relative_phone':   'relative_phone',
    'h_citizenship':      'citizenship'
  };
  Object.keys(map).forEach(function(hid) {
    var src = document.getElementById(map[hid]);
    if (src) document.getElementById(hid).value = src.value;
  });

  // Select elements
  var civilEl = document.getElementById('civil_status');
  var relEl   = document.getElementById('contact_relation');
  document.getElementById('h_civil_status').value     = civilEl ? civilEl.value : '';
  document.getElementById('h_contact_relation').value = relEl   ? relEl.value   : '';

  // Radio buttons
  var sexChecked = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_r"]:checked');
  var bgChecked  = document.querySelector('input[name="bg_r"]:checked');
  var rhChecked  = document.querySelector('input[name="rh_r"]:checked');
  if (sexChecked) document.getElementById('h_sex').value        = sexChecked.value;
  if (bgChecked)  document.getElementById('h_blood_group').value = bgChecked.value;
  if (rhChecked)  document.getElementById('h_rhesus').value      = rhChecked.value;

  // No phone codes — phone numbers include country code typed directly
  document.getElementById('h_phone_1_code').value = '';
  document.getElementById('h_phone_2_code').value = '';

  document.getElementById('patientForm').submit();
});
</script>

              <a class="page-link" href="/patients/list?page=<%= currentPage-1 %>&<%= qBase %>">&laquo;</a>
            </li>
            <% if (winStart > 1) { %>
              <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="/patients/list?page=1&<%= qBase %>">1</a></li>
              <% if (winStart > 2) { %><li class="page-item disabled"><span class="page-link">&hellip;</span></li><% } %>
            <% } %>
            <% for (let i = winStart; i <= winEnd; i++) { %>
              <li class="page-item <%= i === currentPage ? 'active' : '' %>">
                <a class="page-link" href="/patients/list?page=<%= i %>&<%= qBase %>"><%= i %></a>
              </li>
            <% } %>
            <% if (winEnd < totalPages) { %>
              <% if (winEnd < totalPages - 1) { %><li class="page-item disabled"><span class="page-link">&hellip;</span></li><% } %>
              <li class="page-item"><a class="page-link" href="/patients/list?page=<%= totalPages %>&<%= qBase %>"><%= totalPages %></a></li>
            <% } %>
            <li class="page-item <%= currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : '' %>">
              <a class="page-link" href="/patients/list?page=<%= currentPage+1 %>&<%= qBase %>">&raquo;</a>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </nav>
      <% } %>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function exportCSV() {
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#patientsTable tr');
  let csv = '';
  rows.forEach(row => {
    const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('th,td')).slice(0,8);
    csv += cells.map(function(c){ return '"' + c.textContent.trim().replace(/"/g,'""') + '"'; }).join(',') + '\n';
  });
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));
  a.download = 'patients.csv';
  a.click();
}
</script>

<script>
// ── Prescription split pane
function showPrx(encNr, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('#prx-list .list-item').forEach(function(li){li.classList.remove('active');});
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#prx-detail > div').forEach(function(p){p.style.display='none';});
  var panel = document.getElementById('prx-panel-' + encNr);
  if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block';
}

// ── Record bills tab: load items via JSON when bill clicked ──────
var _recBillLoaded = {};

function loadBillItems(billNo, el) {
  // Highlight selected bill
  document.querySelectorAll('#rec-bill-list .list-item').forEach(function(li) {
    li.classList.remove('active');
  });
  if (el) el.classList.add('active');

  var placeholder = document.getElementById('rec-bill-placeholder');
  var content     = document.getElementById('rec-bill-content');
  if (placeholder) placeholder.style.display = 'none';
  if (content) {
    content.style.display = '';
    content.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-4"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-muted"></i></div>';
  }

  // Use cached result if already loaded
  if (_recBillLoaded[billNo]) {
    renderBillItems(billNo, _recBillLoaded[billNo]);
    return;
  }

  fetch('/billing/bill/' + billNo + '/items-json')
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      if (data.ok) {
        _recBillLoaded[billNo] = data;
        renderBillItems(billNo, data);
      } else {
        if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="text-danger p-3">Error: ' + (data.error||'Failed') + '</div>';
      }
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div class="text-danger p-3">Network error: ' + err.message + '</div>';
    });
}

function renderBillItems(billNo, data) {
  var content = document.getElementById('rec-bill-content');
  if (!content) return;

  var bill    = data.bill;
  var items   = data.items;
  var canPay  = <%= (typeof hasAnyPermission !== 'undefined' && hasAnyPermission(['Billing.Collect.Payment','Billing.Create.Invoice'])) ? 'true' : 'false' %>;
  var locale  = '<%= locale %>';
  var isFr    = locale === 'fr';

  var totalAmt = items.reduce(function(s,i){ return s + (i.amount||0); }, 0);
  var paidAmt  = items.filter(function(i){ return i.status==='paid'; })
                      .reduce(function(s,i){ return s + (i.amount||0); }, 0);
  var openAmt  = totalAmt - paidAmt;

  // Header
  var sClass = bill.status==='paid'   ? 'bg-success' :
               bill.status==='partial' ? 'bg-primary'  : 'bg-warning text-dark';
  var sLabel = bill.status==='paid'
    ? (isFr?'Payee':'Paid')
    : bill.status==='partial'
      ? (isFr?'Partielle':'Partial')
      : (isFr?'Ouverte':'Open');

  var payBtn = (bill.status !== 'paid' && canPay)
    ? '<a href="/billing/bill/' + billNo + '#payment-section" class="btn btn-sm btn-success" style="font-size:.70rem;padding:2px 8px;">' +
      '<i class="fas fa-cash-register me-1"></i>' + (isFr?'Payer':'Pay') + '</a>'
    : '';

  var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">' +
    '<span class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.80rem;">' +
    (isFr?'Facture':'Bill') + ' #' + billNo +
    ' <span class="badge ' + sClass + ' ms-1" style="font-size:.60rem;">' + sLabel + '</span>' +
    '</span>' + payBtn + '</div>';

  if (items.length === 0) {
    html += '<div class="text-muted text-center py-3" style="font-size:.78rem;">' +
            (isFr?'Aucun article.':'No items.') + '</div>';
  } else {
    html += '<table class="table table-xs align-middle mb-2"><thead class="table-light"><tr>' +
            '<th>' + (isFr?'Article':'Item') + '</th>' +
            '<th class="text-center">' + (isFr?'Qte':'Qty') + '</th>' +
            '<th class="text-end">Total</th><th>Statut</th></tr></thead><tbody>';

    items.forEach(function(item) {
      var isPaid   = item.status === 'paid';
      var rowStyle = isPaid ? 'opacity:.65;' : '';
      var badgeCls = isPaid ? 'bg-success' : 'bg-warning text-dark';
      var badgeLbl = isPaid ? (isFr?'Paye':'Paid') : (isFr?'Ouvert':'Open');
      html += '<tr style="' + rowStyle + '">' +
        '<td><div style="font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem;">' + item.article + '</div>' +
        (item.class ? '<div style="font-size:.63rem;color:#adb5bd;">' + item.class + '</div>' : '') +
        '</td>' +
        '<td class="text-center">' + item.units + '</td>' +
        '<td class="text-end fw-bold" style="font-size:.78rem;">' +
          Math.round(item.amount||0).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</td>' +
        '<td><span class="badge ' + badgeCls + '" style="font-size:.60rem;">' + badgeLbl + '</span></td>' +
        '</tr>';
    });

    html += '</tbody><tfoot class="table-light">' +
      '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-end" style="font-size:.76rem;">Total</td>' +
      '<td class="text-end fw-bold" style="font-size:.78rem;">' +
        Math.round(totalAmt).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</td><td></td></tr>';

    if (paidAmt > 0) {
      html += '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-end text-success" style="font-size:.72rem;">' +
              (isFr?'Paye':'Paid') + '</td>' +
              '<td class="text-end text-success fw-bold" style="font-size:.72rem;">' +
              Math.round(paidAmt).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</td><td></td></tr>';
      html += '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-end text-danger" style="font-size:.72rem;">' +
              (isFr?'Reste':'Balance') + '</td>' +
              '<td class="text-end text-danger fw-bold" style="font-size:.72rem;">' +
              Math.round(openAmt).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</td><td></td></tr>';
    }
    html += '</tfoot></table>';
  }

  content.innerHTML = html;
}

// Auto-load the first bill when tab is clicked
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

  // Activate tab from ?tab= query param (e.g. after prescription submit)
  var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var tabParam  = urlParams.get('tab');
  if (tabParam) {
    var tabLink = document.querySelector('[href="#tab-' + tabParam + '"]');
    if (tabLink && typeof bootstrap !== 'undefined') {
      var bsTab = new bootstrap.Tab(tabLink);
      bsTab.show();
    }
  }

  // When Billing tab opens: auto-select first bill
  var billingTabEl = document.querySelector('[href="#tab-billing"]');
  if (billingTabEl) {
    billingTabEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab', function() {
      var firstItem = document.querySelector('#bill-list .list-item');
      if (firstItem) {
        var billNo = parseInt(firstItem.id.replace('bill-li-',''));
        if (billNo) showBill(billNo, firstItem);
      }
    });
  }
});

// ── CSRF token for fetch ──────────────────────────────────────────
var _recCsrf = '<%= csrfToken %>';

// ── VITALS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleVitalsForm(encNr) {
  var form = document.getElementById('vitals-form-' + encNr);
  if (!form) return;
  var visible = form.style.display !== 'none';
  form.style.display = visible ? 'none' : '';
  if (!visible) {
    var valEl = document.getElementById('vval-' + encNr);
    if (valEl) valEl.focus();
  }
}
function saveVital(encNr) {
  var typeEl = document.getElementById('vtype-' + encNr);
  var valEl  = document.getElementById('vval-' + encNr);
  var type   = typeEl ? typeEl.value : '';
  var val    = valEl  ? valEl.value.trim() : '';
  if (!val) {
    alert('<%= locale==="fr"?"Veuillez saisir une valeur.":"Please enter a value." %>');
    if (valEl) valEl.focus();
    return;
  }
  var btn = null;
  fetch('/encounters/' + encNr + '/vitals?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_recCsrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ msr_type_nr: type, value: val }),
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(data) {
    if (data.ok) {
      toggleVitalsForm(encNr);
      if (valEl) valEl.value = '';
      window.location.reload();
    } else {
      alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown'));
    }
  });
}

// ── NOTES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function saveNote(encNr) {
  var ta = document.getElementById('note-text-' + encNr);
  var text = ta ? ta.value.trim() : '';
  if (!text) { alert('<%= locale==="fr"?"Veuillez saisir une note.":"Please enter a note." %>'); return; }

  fetch('/encounters/' + encNr + '/notes?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_recCsrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ notes: text }),
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(data) {
    if (data.ok) {
      if (ta) ta.value = '';
      window.location.reload();
    } else {
      alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown'));
    }
  });
}

// ── DIAGNOSES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var _dxCarts   = {};  // { encNr: [ {code, label, type} ] }
var _dxTimers  = {};

function dxSearch(encNr, q) {
  clearTimeout(_dxTimers[encNr]);
  var resultsEl = document.getElementById('dx-results-' + encNr);
  if (!q || q.length < 2) {
    if (resultsEl) resultsEl.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  _dxTimers[encNr] = setTimeout(function() {
    fetch('/encounters/cim10/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q))
      .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!resultsEl) return;
        if (!data.ok || data.results.length === 0) {
          resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="dx-result-item text-muted"><%= locale==="fr"?"Aucun resultat.":"No results." %></div>';
          resultsEl.style.display = '';
          return;
        }
        var html = '';
        data.results.forEach(function(r) {
          html += '<div class="dx-result-item" onclick="addDxToCart(' + encNr + ',' +
            JSON.stringify(r).replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + ')">' +
            '<code style="color:#dc3545;font-size:.72rem;">' + r.code + '</code>' +
            ' <span>' + r.label + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
        });
        resultsEl.innerHTML = html;
        resultsEl.style.display = '';
      });
  }, 300);
}

function addDxToCart(encNr, item) {
  if (!_dxCarts[encNr]) _dxCarts[encNr] = [];
  var already = _dxCarts[encNr].some(function(d){ return d.code === item.code; });
  if (already) return;
  _dxCarts[encNr].push({ code: item.code, label: item.label, type: 'main' });
  renderDxCart(encNr);
  // Clear search
  var inp = document.getElementById('dx-search-' + encNr);
  var res = document.getElementById('dx-results-' + encNr);
  if (inp) inp.value = '';
  if (res) res.style.display = 'none';
}

function removeDxFromCart(encNr, code) {
  if (!_dxCarts[encNr]) return;
  _dxCarts[encNr] = _dxCarts[encNr].filter(function(d){ return d.code !== code; });
  renderDxCart(encNr);
}

function renderDxCart(encNr) {
  var cartEl   = document.getElementById('dx-cart-' + encNr);
  var saveWrap = document.getElementById('dx-save-wrap-' + encNr);
  if (!cartEl) return;
  var cart = _dxCarts[encNr] || [];
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    cartEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (saveWrap) saveWrap.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  if (saveWrap) saveWrap.style.display = '';
  var html = '';
  cart.forEach(function(d) {
    html += '<span class="dx-cart-tag">' +
      '<code style="color:#dc3545;">' + d.code + '</code>' +
      ' ' + d.label +
      '<button onclick="removeDxFromCart(' + encNr + ','' + d.code + '')" ' +
      'style="background:none;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;font-size:.7rem;color:#6c757d;">' +
      '<i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>' +
      '</span>';
  });
  cartEl.innerHTML = html;
}

function saveDiagnoses(encNr) {
  var cart = _dxCarts[encNr] || [];
  if (cart.length === 0) return;

  fetch('/encounters/' + encNr + '/diagnoses?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_recCsrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ diagnoses: cart }),
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(data) {
    if (data.ok) {
      _dxCarts[encNr] = [];
      window.location.reload();
    } else {
      alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown'));
    }
  });
}

function deleteDx(dxNr, btn) {
  if (!confirm('<%= locale==="fr"?"Supprimer ce diagnostic ?":"Remove this diagnosis?" %>')) return;
  fetch('/encounters/diagnoses/' + dxNr + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_recCsrf), {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(data) {
    if (data.ok) {
      var badge = document.getElementById('dx-badge-' + dxNr);
      if (badge) badge.remove();
    } else {
      alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown'));
    }
  });
}

// Close dx dropdown on outside click
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (!e.target.closest('.dx-search-wrap')) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dx-results').forEach(function(el) {
      el.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }
});

// ── Past encounter expand/collapse
function togglePast(i) {
  var det = document.getElementById('past-det-' + i);
  var ico = document.getElementById('past-ico-' + i);
  var hdr = document.getElementById('past-hdr-' + i);
  if (det.style.display === 'block') {
    det.style.display = 'none';
    ico.className = 'fas fa-chevron-right text-muted';
    ico.style.fontSize = '.6rem';
    hdr.parentElement.classList.remove('open');
  } else {
    det.style.display = 'block';
    ico.className = 'fas fa-chevron-down text-primary';
    ico.style.fontSize = '.6rem';
    hdr.parentElement.classList.add('open');
  }
}

function toggleAllPast() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="past-det-"]').forEach(function(d){d.style.display='none';});
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="past-ico-"]').forEach(function(i){
    i.className = 'fas fa-chevron-right text-muted'; i.style.fontSize='.6rem';
  });
}

<script>
var _csrf  = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _bill  = <%= billNo %>;
var locale = '<%= locale %>';

function dispenseItem(billItemId) {
  var qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('qty_'+billItemId).value, 10);
  if (isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) { alert(locale==='fr'?'Quantite invalide.':'Invalid quantity.'); return; }
  fetch('/pharmacy/dispense/item/'+billItemId+'?_csrf='+encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ qty_dispensed: qty }),
  })
  .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
  .then(function(d){
    if (d.ok) {
      var card = document.getElementById('itemCard_'+billItemId);
      if (card) {
        card.classList.add('dispensed');
        card.innerHTML = '<div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">'
          + '<i class="fas fa-check-circle" style="color:#1a9e72;font-size:1.2rem;"></i>'
          + '<div><div class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.80rem;">'+(locale==='fr'?'Distribue':'Dispensed')+'</div>'
          + '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:.72rem;">'+d.qty_dispensed+' '+(locale==='fr'?'unites':'units')+'</div></div></div>';
      }
    } else {
      alert(d.error || 'Error');
    }
  });
}

function dispenseAll() {
  if (!confirm(locale==='fr'?'Distribuer tous les articles disponibles ?':'Dispense all available items?')) return;
  fetch('/pharmacy/dispense/'+_bill+'/all?_csrf='+encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({}),
  })
  .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
  .then(function(d){
    if (d.ok) {
      var msg = (locale==='fr'?'Distribue: ':'Dispensed: ')+d.dispensed+(locale==='fr'?' article(s)':' item(s)');
      if (d.skipped > 0) msg += ' — '+(locale==='fr'?'Omis (stock insuffisant): ':'Skipped (low stock): ')+d.skipped;
      alert(msg);
      window.location.reload();
    } else { alert(d.error || 'Error'); }
  });
}
</script>

<script>
function calcVariance(idx) {
  var input   = document.querySelector('input[data-row="'+idx+'"]');
  var system  = parseInt(input.dataset.system, 10);
  var counted = parseInt(input.value, 10);
  var cell    = document.getElementById('variance_'+idx);
  if (isNaN(counted)) { cell.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">—</span>'; return; }
  var diff = counted - system;
  if (diff === 0) {
    cell.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">0</span>';
  } else if (diff > 0) {
    cell.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#198754;font-weight:700;">+'+diff+'</span>';
  } else {
    cell.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#dc3545;font-weight:700;">'+diff+'</span>';
  }
}
</script>

<script>
var _csrf   = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _id     = <%= order.order_id %>;
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';

function doAction(action) {
  var msgs = {
    fulfil:  _locale==='fr'?'Preparer cette commande (FEFO applique) ?':'Fulfil this order (FEFO will be applied)?',
    collect: _locale==='fr'?'Confirmer la collecte ?':'Confirm collection?',
    cancel:  _locale==='fr'?'Annuler cette commande ?':'Cancel this order?',
  };
  if (!confirm(msgs[action])) return;
  fetch('/pharmacy/orders/' + _id + '/' + action + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({}),
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(d) {
    if (d.ok) {
      window.location.href = '/pharmacy/orders/' + _id + '?success=' + action;
    } else {
      alert(d.error || 'Error');
    }
  });
}
</script>

<%
  var productsJson = JSON.stringify(products.map(function(p){
    return {
      id:    p.product_id,
      name:  p.name,
      code:  p.item_code,
      unit:  p.unit_of_measure,
      stock: p.current_stock,
      cat:   p.category ? p.category.name : ''
    };
  }));
%>

<script>
var PRODUCTS  = <%- productsJson %>;
var itemCount = 0;
var locale    = '<%= locale %>';

function addItem() {
  var idx = itemCount++;
  var opts = PRODUCTS.map(function(p) {
    return '<option value="'+p.id+'" data-unit="'+p.unit+'" data-stock="'+p.stock+'">'
      + p.name + ' ['+p.code+'] — '
      + (p.stock > 0
          ? (locale==='fr'?'Stock: ':'Stock: ')+p.stock+' '+p.unit
          : (locale==='fr'?'Rupture':'Out of stock'))
      + '</option>';
  }).join('');

  var html = '<div class="item-row" id="item_'+idx+'">'
    + '<div class="d-flex gap-2 flex-wrap align-items-end">'
    + '<div style="flex:2;min-width:200px;">'
    + '<label class="lbl">'+(locale==='fr'?'Produit':'Product')+' <span class="req">*</span></label>'
    + '<select name="items['+idx+'][product_id]" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="updateStock('+idx+',this)" required>'
    + '<option value="">-- '+(locale==='fr'?'Choisir':'Select')+' --</option>'
    + opts
    + '</select></div>'
    + '<div style="width:110px;">'
    + '<label class="lbl">'+(locale==='fr'?'Quantite':'Qty')+' <span class="req">*</span></label>'
    + '<input type="number" name="items['+idx+'][quantity_requested]" class="form-control form-control-sm" min="1" required>'
    + '</div>'
    + '<div id="stockInfo_'+idx+'" style="font-size:.72rem;padding-bottom:6px;"></div>'
    + '<div>'
    + '<label class="lbl">&nbsp;</label>'
    + '<button type="button" class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger" onclick="removeItem('+idx+')">'
    + '<i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>'
    + '</div>'
    + '</div>'
    + '</div>';

  document.getElementById('itemsContainer').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
  updateSubmitBtn();
}

function updateStock(idx, sel) {
  var opt   = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  var stock = parseInt(opt.dataset.stock || '0', 10);
  var unit  = opt.dataset.unit || '';
  var info  = document.getElementById('stockInfo_'+idx);
  if (!opt.value) { info.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  if (stock <= 0) {
    info.innerHTML = '<span class="stock-zero"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle me-1"></i>'
      + (locale==='fr'?'Rupture de stock':'Out of stock') + '</span>';
  } else if (stock < 10) {
    info.innerHTML = '<span class="stock-low"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-1"></i>'
      + (locale==='fr'?'Stock bas: ':'Low stock: ') + stock + ' ' + unit + '</span>';
  } else {
    info.innerHTML = '<span class="stock-ok"><i class="fas fa-check me-1"></i>'
      + (locale==='fr'?'Disponible: ':'Available: ') + stock + ' ' + unit + '</span>';
  }
  updateSubmitBtn();
}

function removeItem(idx) {
  var el = document.getElementById('item_'+idx);
  if (el) el.remove();
  updateSubmitBtn();
}

function updateSubmitBtn() {
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.item-row');
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = rows.length === 0;
}

// Add first item automatically
addItem();
</script>

<script>
var _csrf  = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var locale = '<%= locale %>';
var _adjustItemId = null;

function showAdjustFromEl(btn) {
  _adjustItemId = btn.dataset.id;
  document.getElementById('adjustItemName').textContent = decodeURIComponent(btn.dataset.name);
  document.getElementById('adjustCurrent').textContent  = btn.dataset.qty;
  document.getElementById('adjQty').value    = '';
  document.getElementById('adjReason').value = '';
  new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('adjustModal')).show();
}
function saveAdjust() {
  var qty    = document.getElementById('adjQty').value;
  var reason = document.getElementById('adjReason').value;
  if (!qty || qty === '0') { alert(locale==='fr'?'Quantite requise.':'Quantity required.'); return; }
  fetch('/pharmacy/stock/'+_adjustItemId+'/adjust?_csrf='+encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ qty_adjustment: qty, reason: reason }),
  })
  .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
  .then(function(d){
    if (d.ok) { window.location.reload(); }
    else { alert(d.error || 'Error'); }
  });
}
</script>

<script>
var _csrf    = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _encNr   = <%= encounter.encounter_nr %>;
var _locale  = '<%= locale %>';
var _isFr    = _locale === 'fr';
var _cart    = [];
var _selItem = null;
var _searchTimer = null;

// ── Item search ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('item-search').addEventListener('input', function() {
    clearTimeout(_searchTimer);
    var q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
        document.getElementById('search-results').style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    _searchTimer = setTimeout(function() { doSearch(q); }, 300);
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.search-wrap')) {
        document.getElementById('search-results').style.display = 'none';
    }
});

function doSearch(q) {
    fetch('/prescriptions/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q))
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            var box = document.getElementById('search-results');
            if (!data.ok || data.items.length === 0) {
                box.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result text-muted">' +
                    (_isFr ? 'Aucun resultat.' : 'No results.') + '</div>';
                box.style.display = '';
                return;
            }
            var html = '';
            data.items.forEach(function(item) {
                html += '<div class="search-result" onclick="selectItem(' +
                    JSON.stringify(item).replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + ')">' +
                    '<div class="fw-bold">' + item.description + '</div>' +
                    '<div style="font-size:.68rem;color:#6c757d;">' +
                    item.item_number + ' &bull; ' + item.drug_class +
                    ' &bull; <strong>' + Math.round(item.price).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</strong>' +
                    '</div></div>';
            });
            box.innerHTML = html;
            box.style.display = '';
        });
}

function selectItem(item) {
    _selItem = item;
    document.getElementById('search-results').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('item-search').value = item.description;
    document.getElementById('selected-item-name').textContent = item.description;
    document.getElementById('selected-item-price').textContent =
        Math.round(item.price).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';
    document.getElementById('inp-units').value  = 1;
    document.getElementById('inp-dosage').value = '';
    document.getElementById('inp-notes').value  = '';
    document.getElementById('selected-item-form').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('inp-dosage').focus();
}

function clearItemForm() {
    _selItem = null;
    document.getElementById('item-search').value = '';
    document.getElementById('selected-item-form').style.display = 'none';
}

// ── Cart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function addToCart() {
    if (!_selItem) return;
    var units   = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('inp-units').value) || 1);
    var dosage  = document.getElementById('inp-dosage').value.trim();
    var apptype = document.getElementById('inp-apptype').value;
    var notes   = document.getElementById('inp-notes').value.trim();

    if (!dosage) {
        alert(_isFr ? 'Veuillez saisir la posologie.' : 'Please enter the dosage.');
        document.getElementById('inp-dosage').focus();
        return;
    }
    if (!notes) {
        alert(_isFr ? 'Veuillez saisir les instructions.' : 'Please enter the instructions/notes.');
        document.getElementById('inp-notes').focus();
        return;
    }

    var total = Math.round(_selItem.price * units);
    _cart.push({
        item_id:            _selItem.item_id,
        description:        _selItem.description,
        drug_class:         _selItem.drug_class,
        price:              _selItem.price,
        units:              units,
        dosage:             dosage,
        application_type_nr: apptype,
        notes:              notes,
        total:              total,
    });

    clearItemForm();
    renderCart();
}

function removeFromCart(idx) {
    _cart.splice(idx, 1);
    renderCart();
}

function renderCart() {
    var count = _cart.length;
    document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent = count;

    var grandTotal = _cart.reduce(function(s, i) { return s + i.total; }, 0);
    document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent =
        Math.round(grandTotal).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';

    var empty   = document.getElementById('cart-empty');
    var items   = document.getElementById('cart-items');
    var footer  = document.getElementById('cart-footer');

    if (count === 0) {
        empty.style.display  = '';
        items.innerHTML      = '';
        footer.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    empty.style.display  = 'none';
    footer.style.display = '';

    var html = '';
    _cart.forEach(function(item, idx) {
        html += '<div class="cart-row px-3">' +
            '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start">' +
            '<div style="flex:1;">' +
            '<div class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.80rem;">' + item.description + '</div>' +
            '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:.70rem;">' +
            (_isFr?'Qte:':'Qty:') + ' ' + item.units +
            ' &bull; ' + (_isFr?'Posologie:':'Dosage:') + ' ' + item.dosage +
            ' &bull; ' + item.notes + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="ms-2 text-end">' +
            '<div class="fw-bold text-primary" style="font-size:.80rem;">' +
            Math.round(item.total).toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA</div>' +
            '<button class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger mt-1" style="font-size:.62rem;padding:1px 5px;"' +
            ' onclick="removeFromCart(' + idx + ')">' +
            '<i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>' +
            '</div></div></div>';
    });
    items.innerHTML = html;
}

// ── Submit prescription ───────────────────────────────────────────
function submitPrescription() {
    if (_cart.length === 0) return;
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit-prx');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin me-2"></i>' +
        (_isFr ? 'Traitement...' : 'Processing...');

    var payload = { items: _cart.map(function(c) {
        return {
            item_id:            c.item_id,
            dosage:             c.dosage,
            application_type_nr: c.application_type_nr,
            notes:              c.notes,
            units:              c.units,
        };
    })};

    fetch('/prescriptions/encounter/' + _encNr + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
        method:  'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body:    JSON.stringify(payload),
    })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
        if (data.ok) {
            window.location.href = data.redirect;
        } else {
            alert((_isFr ? 'Erreur: ' : 'Error: ') + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>' +
                (_isFr ? 'Valider la prescription' : 'Submit Prescription');
        }
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
        alert('Network error: ' + err.message);
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check me-2"></i>' +
            (_isFr ? 'Valider la prescription' : 'Submit Prescription');
    });
}

// ── Stop prescription ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function stopPrx(prxNr, btn) {
    if (!confirm(_isFr ? 'Arreter cette prescription ?' : 'Stop this prescription?')) return;
    btn.disabled = true;

    fetch('/prescriptions/' + prxNr + '/stop?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    })
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
        if (data.ok) {
            var row = document.getElementById('prx-row-' + prxNr);
            if (row) {
                row.style.opacity = '0.4';
                row.style.textDecoration = 'line-through';
                btn.remove();
            }
        } else {
            alert('Error: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown'));
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    });
}
</script>

<%- include('../partials/footer') %>

<script>
  function debounce(func, delay) {
    let timeout;
    return function(...args) { clearTimeout(timeout); timeout = setTimeout(() => func.apply(this, args), delay); };
  }

  document.getElementById('personSearch').addEventListener('input', debounce(function () {
    const q = this.value;
    const sel = document.getElementById('person_id');
    while (sel.options.length > 1) sel.remove(1);
    if (q.length < 3) return;
    fetch('/admin/users/personnel-search?query=' + encodeURIComponent(q)')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => data.forEach(p => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = p.pid;
        opt.textContent = (p.name_first || '') + ' ' + (p.name_last || '') + ' (PID: ' + p.pid + ')';
        opt.dataset.firstname = p.name_first || '';
        opt.dataset.lastname  = p.name_last  || '';
        opt.dataset.email     = p.email      || '';
        sel.appendChild(opt);
      }));
  }, 300));

  document.getElementById('person_id').addEventListener('change', function () {
    const opt = this.options[this.selectedIndex];
    if (opt.value) {
      const last  = opt.dataset.lastname;
      const first = opt.dataset.firstname;
      let uname = last.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
      if (first.length >= 2) uname += first.substring(0, 2).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
      document.getElementById('username').value = uname;
      document.getElementById('email').value    = opt.dataset.email;
    } else {
      document.getElementById('username').value = '';
      document.getElementById('email').value    = '';
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
function debounce(fn, ms) {
  let t; return function(...a) { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this,a), ms); };
}

const userSearch = document.getElementById('userSearch');
const userSelect = document.getElementById('user_id');

// Live search as user types
userSearch.addEventListener('input', debounce(function() {
  const q = this.value.trim();
  while (userSelect.options.length > 1) userSelect.remove(1);
  if (q.length < 2) return;
  fetch('/admin/users/user-search?query=' + encodeURIComponent(q))
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(data => data.forEach(u => {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = u.user_id;
      const name = u.personData
        ? ((u.personData.name_first || '') + ' ' + (u.personData.name_last || '')).trim()
        : '';
      opt.textContent = u.username + (name ? ' — ' + name : '');
      userSelect.appendChild(opt);
    }));
}, 300));

// Double-click on option = load immediately
userSelect.addEventListener('dblclick', function() {
  if (this.value) document.getElementById('selectForm').submit();
});
</script>

<script>
var _csrf     = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _delivId  = <%= delivery.delivery_id %>;
var _locale   = '<%= locale %>';

function apiPost(url, body) {
  return fetch(url + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
}

function submitQC() {
  var results = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.qc-result').forEach(function(sel) {
    var itemId = sel.dataset.itemId;
    results.push({
      delivery_item_id: itemId,
      result:           sel.value,
      qty_accepted:     document.querySelector('.qc-accepted[data-item-id="'+itemId+'"]').value,
      qty_rejected:     document.querySelector('.qc-rejected[data-item-id="'+itemId+'"]').value,
      temperature_ok:   document.querySelector('.qc-temp[data-item-id="'+itemId+'"]').value,
      rejection_reason: document.querySelector('.qc-reason[data-item-id="'+itemId+'"]').value,
    });
  });
  if (!results.length) { alert(_locale==='fr'?'Aucun article à valider.':'No items to QC.'); return; }
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Confirmer le contrôle qualité ?':'Confirm QC results?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/deliveries/' + _delivId + '/qc', { results: results })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) { window.location.href = '/warehouse/deliveries/' + _delivId + '?success=qc'; }
      else { alert(d.error); }
    });
}

function shelveItems() {
  var shelves = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.shelve-location').forEach(function(sel) {
    if (sel.value) shelves.push({ delivery_item_id: sel.dataset.itemId, location_id: sel.value });
  });
  if (!shelves.length) { alert(_locale==='fr'?'Veuillez sélectionner au moins un emplacement.':'Please select at least one location.'); return; }
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Ranger ces articles en stock ?':'Shelve these items to stock?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/deliveries/' + _delivId + '/shelve', { shelves: shelves })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) { window.location.href = '/warehouse/deliveries/' + _delivId + '?success=shelved'; }
      else { alert(d.error); }
    });
}
</script>

                          <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:.76rem;"><%= item.variance_reason||'' %></span>
                        <% } %>
                      </td>
                      <td class="text-center" style="font-size:.72rem;color:#6c757d;">
                        <%= item.counted_by || '' %>
                        <% if (item.counted_at) { %><div><%= new Date(item.counted_at).toLocaleDateString(locale==='fr'?'fr-FR':'en-GB') %></div><% } %>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  <% }); %>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          <% } %>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

<script>
var _csrf    = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _countId = <%= count.count_id %>;
var _locale  = '<%= locale %>';

function apiPost(url, body) {
  return fetch(url + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
}

function updateVariance(inp) {
  var row    = inp.closest('tr');
  var sysQty = parseInt(row.cells[2].textContent.trim()) || 0;
  var cntQty = parseInt(inp.value);
  var varEl  = row.querySelector('[id^="var-"]');
  if (isNaN(cntQty)) { varEl.textContent = '—'; varEl.className = 'variance-cell'; return; }
  var v = cntQty - sysQty;
  varEl.textContent = v > 0 ? '+' + v : v;
  varEl.className   = 'variance-cell ' + (v > 0 ? 'var-pos' : v < 0 ? 'var-neg' : 'var-zero');
  varEl.style.cssText = 'padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.80rem;';
}

function collectResults() {
  var results = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.counted-qty').forEach(function(inp) {
    var itemId = inp.dataset.itemId;
    var cntQty = inp.value;
    var reason = (document.querySelector('.variance-reason[data-item-id="' + itemId + '"]') || {}).value || '';
    if (cntQty !== '') results.push({ item_id: itemId, counted_qty: cntQty, variance_reason: reason });
  });
  return results;
}

function startCount() {
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Démarrer l\'inventaire ? Les mouvements de stock seront verrouillés.':'Start the count? Stock movements will be locked.')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/start')
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function saveAllResults() {
  var results = collectResults();
  if (results.length === 0) { alert(_locale==='fr'?'Aucune valeur saisie.':'No values entered.'); return; }
  apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/results', { results: results })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function submitCount() {
  // Auto-save first
  var results = collectResults();
  var doSubmit = function() {
    apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/submit')
      .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
  };
  if (results.length > 0) {
    apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/results', { results: results })
      .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) doSubmit(); else alert(d.error); });
  } else { doSubmit(); }
}

function approveCount() {
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Approuver et appliquer tous les ajustements de stock ?':'Approve and apply all stock adjustments?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/approve')
    .then(function(d){
      if (d.ok) {
        alert((d.adjustments || 0) + (_locale==='fr'?' ajustement(s) appliqué(s).':' adjustment(s) applied.'));
        location.reload();
      } else { alert(d.error); }
    });
}

function cancelCount() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale === 'fr' ? 'Raison de l\'annulation:' : 'Reason for cancellation:');
  if (reason === null) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/inventory-counts/' + _countId + '/cancel', { reason: reason })
    .then(function(d) { if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}
</script>

<script>
var _csrf  = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _id    = <%= order.order_id %>;
var locale = '<%= locale %>';

function doFulfil() {
  if (!confirm(locale==='fr'
    ? 'Valider cette commande ? Le stock entrepot sera deduit (FEFO) et les articles mis en transit.'
    : 'Process this order? Warehouse stock will be deducted (FEFO) and items placed in transit.')) return;
  fetch('/pharmacy/orders/' + _id + '/fulfil?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({}),
  })
  .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
  .then(function(d) {
    if (d.ok) {
      window.location.href = '/warehouse/pharmacy-orders/' + _id + '?success=fulfilled';
    } else {
      alert(d.error || 'Error');
    }
  });
}
</script>

<script>
var _csrf   = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';
var _poId   = <%= po.po_id %>;

function apiPost(url, body) {
  return fetch(url + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
}

function submitPo() {
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr' ? 'Soumettre pour approbation du Directeur ?' : 'Submit for Director approval?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/submit')
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function approvePo(level) {
  var msg = _locale==='fr' ? 'Confirmer l\'approbation ?' : 'Confirm approval?';
  if (!confirm(msg)) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/approve/' + level)
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function rejectPo() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale==='fr' ? 'Raison du rejet (optionnel):' : 'Reason for rejection (optional):');
  if (reason === null) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/reject', { reason: reason })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function markSent() {
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr' ? 'Confirmer l\'envoi au fournisseur ?' : 'Confirm this PO has been sent to the supplier?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/send')
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function cancelPo() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale==='fr' ? 'Raison de l\'annulation:' : 'Reason for cancellation:');
  if (reason === null) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/cancel', { reason: reason })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function closePo() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale==='fr' ? 'Raison de la clôture (ex: fournisseur ne peut livrer le reste):' : 'Reason for closing (e.g. vendor cannot fulfil remainder):');
  if (reason === null) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/close', { reason: reason })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function removeItem(poId, itemId) {
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr' ? 'Supprimer cet article ?' : 'Remove this item?')) return;
  fetch('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + poId + '/items/' + itemId + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'DELETE',
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function addItemToPo() {
  var sel   = document.getElementById('addItemSel');
  var pid   = parseInt(sel.value);
  if (!pid) { alert(_locale==='fr' ? 'Choisir un produit.' : 'Select a product.'); return; }
  var qty   = parseInt(document.getElementById('addItemQty').value)    || 1;
  var price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('addItemPrice').value) || 0;

  fetch('/warehouse/purchase-orders/' + _poId + '/items?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: pid, quantity_ordered: qty, unit_price: price }),
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

// Fetch preferred price on product select (add item section)
var addItemSel = document.getElementById('addItemSel');
if (addItemSel) {
  addItemSel.addEventListener('change', function() {
    var pid = parseInt(this.value);
    if (!pid) return;
    fetch('/warehouse/purchase-orders/product/' + pid + '/price?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf))
      .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
      .then(function(d){
        if (d.ok) {
          document.getElementById('addItemPrice').value = d.unit_price || 0;
          if (d.reorder_quantity > 0) document.getElementById('addItemQty').value = d.reorder_quantity;
        }
      }).catch(function(){});
  });
}
</script>

<script>
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';
var _csrf   = '<%= csrfToken %>';

// Track product IDs already in the PO
var usedIds = new Set([
  <% if (prefillItems && prefillItems.length > 0) { %>
    <% prefillItems.forEach(function(p,i){ %><%= p.product_id %><%= i < prefillItems.length-1 ? ',' : '' %><% }); %>
  <% } %>
]);

// Remove available options already in order
function refreshDropdown() {
  var sel = document.getElementById('addProductSel');
  Array.from(sel.options).forEach(function(opt) {
    opt.hidden = opt.value && usedIds.has(parseInt(opt.value));
  });
  updateCount();
  updateTotal();
}

function updateCount() {
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#itemsContainer .item-row');
  document.getElementById('itemCount').textContent = rows.length;
  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = rows.length ? 'none' : '';
}

function updateTotal() {
  var total = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#itemsContainer .item-row').forEach(function(row) {
    var pid   = row.id.replace('item-row-','');
    var qty   = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.qty-input').value)   || 0;
    var price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.price-input').value) || 0;
    var line  = qty * price;
    total += line;
    var el = document.getElementById('total-' + pid);
    if (el) el.textContent = line.toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';
  });
  document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = total.toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA';
}

function removeItem(pid, btn) {
  var row = document.getElementById('item-row-' + pid);
  if (row) row.remove();
  usedIds.delete(pid);
  refreshDropdown();
}

// Live recalc on qty/price change
document.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
  if (e.target.classList.contains('qty-input') || e.target.classList.contains('price-input')) {
    updateTotal();
  }
});

// Fetch preferred price when product selected
document.getElementById('addProductSel').addEventListener('change', function() {
  var pid = parseInt(this.value);
  if (!pid) return;
  var opt = this.options[this.selectedIndex];
  document.getElementById('addQty').value = parseInt(opt.dataset.qty) || 1;
  // Fetch price
  fetch('/warehouse/purchase-orders/product/' + pid + '/price?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf))
    .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) document.getElementById('addPrice').value = d.unit_price || 0; })
    .catch(function(){});
});

document.getElementById('addProductBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var sel   = document.getElementById('addProductSel');
  var pid   = parseInt(sel.value);
  if (!pid || usedIds.has(pid)) return;

  var opt   = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  var name  = opt.dataset.name;
  var code  = opt.dataset.code;
  var unit  = opt.dataset.unit;
  var qty   = parseInt(document.getElementById('addQty').value)   || 1;
  var price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('addPrice').value) || 0;
  var line  = qty * price;

  var html =
    '<div class="item-row" id="item-row-' + pid + '">' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger remove-btn" onclick="removeItem(' + pid + ', this)">' +
        '<i class="fas fa-times"></i>' +
      '</button>' +
      '<input type="hidden" name="product_ids[]" value="' + pid + '">' +
      '<div class="d-flex align-items-start gap-3 flex-wrap">' +
        '<div style="flex:1;min-width:160px;">' +
          '<div class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.82rem;">' + name + '</div>' +
          '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:.70rem;"><code>' + code + '</code> &bull; ' + unit + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="width:90px;">' +
          '<div class="lbl">' + (_locale==='fr'?'Qté':'Qty') + '</div>' +
          '<input type="number" name="quantities[]" class="form-control form-control-sm qty-input" data-pid="' + pid + '" value="' + qty + '" min="1" required>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="width:130px;">' +
          '<div class="lbl">' + (_locale==='fr'?'Prix unit. (FCFA)':'Unit Price (FCFA)') + '</div>' +
          '<input type="number" name="unit_prices[]" class="form-control form-control-sm price-input" data-pid="' + pid + '" value="' + price + '" min="0" step="0.01">' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="width:110px;">' +
          '<div class="lbl">Total</div>' +
          '<div class="fw-bold text-primary line-total" style="font-size:.82rem;padding-top:6px;" id="total-' + pid + '">' +
            line.toLocaleString('fr-FR') + ' FCFA' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';

  // Remove empty message
  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = 'none';

  document.getElementById('itemsContainer').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
  usedIds.add(pid);
  sel.value = '';
  document.getElementById('addQty').value = 1;
  document.getElementById('addPrice').value = 0;
  refreshDropdown();
});

// Init
refreshDropdown();
</script>

<script>
// Warn if qty received > remaining
document.querySelectorAll('.qty-input').forEach(function(inp) {
  inp.addEventListener('input', function() {
    var remaining = parseInt(this.dataset.remaining) || 0;
    var val       = parseInt(this.value) || 0;
    if (val > remaining) {
      this.classList.add('is-invalid');
    } else {
      this.classList.remove('is-invalid');
    }
  });
});

// Validate expiry dates are in the future before submit
document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  var today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  var ok = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.expiry-input').forEach(function(inp) {
    var row = inp.closest('.item-receive-card');
    var qtyInp = row ? row.querySelector('.qty-input') : null;
    var qty = qtyInp ? (parseInt(qtyInp.value) || 0) : 1;
    if (qty > 0 && inp.value && inp.value < today) {
      inp.classList.add('is-invalid');
      ok = false;
    } else {
      inp.classList.remove('is-invalid');
    }
  });
  if (!ok) {
    e.preventDefault();
    alert('<%= locale==="fr" ? "Certaines dates de péremption sont dépassées. Veuillez vérifier." : "Some expiry dates are in the past. Please check." %>');
  }
});
</script>

<script>
var _csrf  = '<%= csrfToken %>';
var _rfqId = <%= rfq.rfq_id %>;
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';

function apiPost(url, body) {
  return fetch(url + '?_csrf=' + encodeURIComponent(_csrf), {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); });
}

function apiAction(action) {
  var msgs = { submit: _locale==='fr'?'Soumettre pour approbation ?':'Submit for manager approval?',
    approve: _locale==='fr'?'Approuver cette RFQ ?':'Approve this RFQ?',
    send: _locale==='fr'?'Marquer comme envoyée au fournisseur ?':'Mark as sent to suppliers?' };
  if (!confirm(msgs[action] || 'Confirm?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/rfq/' + _rfqId + '/' + action)
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function cancelRfq() {
  var reason = prompt(_locale==='fr'?'Raison de l\'annulation:':'Reason for cancellation:');
  if (reason === null) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/rfq/' + _rfqId + '/cancel', { reason: reason })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function showQuoteEntry()  { document.getElementById('quoteEntrySection').style.display = ''; }
function hideQuoteEntry()  { document.getElementById('quoteEntrySection').style.display = 'none'; }

function saveQuotes() {
  var quotes = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.qe-price').forEach(function(inp) {
    var sid = inp.dataset.sid; var pid = inp.dataset.pid;
    quotes.push({
      supplier_id:        parseInt(sid),
      product_id:         parseInt(pid),
      unit_price:         parseFloat(inp.value) || 0,
      quantity_available: parseInt(document.querySelector('.qe-qty[data-sid="'+sid+'"][data-pid="'+pid+'"]').value) || 0,
      lead_time_days:     parseInt(document.querySelector('.qe-lead[data-sid="'+sid+'"][data-pid="'+pid+'"]').value) || 0,
      notes:              document.querySelector('.qe-notes[data-sid="'+sid+'"][data-pid="'+pid+'"]').value || '',
    });
  });
  apiPost('/warehouse/rfq/' + _rfqId + '/quotes', { quotes: quotes })
    .then(function(d){ if (d.ok) location.reload(); else alert(d.error); });
}

function generatePos() {
  var selections = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="sel-"]').forEach(function(sel) {
    var pid = sel.dataset.pid;
    var sid = sel.value;
    if (sid) selections.push({ supplier_id: parseInt(sid), product_id: parseInt(pid) });
  });
  if (selections.length === 0) {
    alert(_locale==='fr'?'Veuillez sélectionner au moins un fournisseur par produit.':'Please select at least one supplier per product.');
    return;
  }
  if (!confirm(_locale==='fr'?'Générer les bons de commande et clôturer la RFQ ?':'Generate POs and close this RFQ?')) return;
  apiPost('/warehouse/rfq/' + _rfqId + '/generate-pos', { selections: selections })
    .then(function(d) {
      if (d.ok) {
        alert((d.pos.length) + (_locale==='fr'?' bon(s) de commande créé(s).'  :' purchase order(s) created.'));
        location.reload();
      } else { alert(d.error); }
    });
}
</script>

<script>
var _locale = '<%= locale %>';
var usedIds = new Set();
var supplierIds = new Set();

function updateCount() {
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#itemsContainer .item-row');
  document.getElementById('itemCount').textContent = rows.length;
  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = rows.length ? 'none' : '';
}

function removeItem(pid) {
  var row = document.getElementById('item-row-' + pid);
  if (row) row.remove();
  usedIds.delete(pid);
  var opt = document.querySelector('#addProductSel option[value="' + pid + '"]');
  if (opt) opt.hidden = false;
  updateCount();
}

document.getElementById('addProductBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var sel  = document.getElementById('addProductSel');
  var pid  = parseInt(sel.value);
  if (!pid || usedIds.has(pid)) return;
  var opt  = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  var name = opt.dataset.name;
  var code = opt.dataset.code;
  var unit = opt.dataset.unit;
  var qty  = parseInt(document.getElementById('addQty').value) || 1;

  var html =
    '<div class="item-row" id="item-row-' + pid + '">' +
      '<input type="hidden" name="product_ids[]" value="' + pid + '">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;min-width:160px;">' +
        '<div class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.82rem;">' + name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:.70rem;"><code>' + code + '</code> &bull; ' + unit + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="width:130px;">' +
        '<div class="lbl">' + (_locale==='fr'?'Qté demandée':'Qty Requested') + '</div>' +
        '<input type="number" name="quantities[]" class="form-control form-control-sm" value="' + qty + '" min="1" required>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger remove-btn" onclick="removeItem(' + pid + ')">' +
        '<i class="fas fa-times"></i>' +
      '</button>' +
    '</div>';

  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('itemsContainer').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
  usedIds.add(pid);
  opt.hidden = true;
  sel.value = '';
  document.getElementById('addQty').value = 1;
  updateCount();
});

// Supplier chips
document.getElementById('supplierSel').addEventListener('change', function() {
  var sid  = parseInt(this.value);
  var name = this.options[this.selectedIndex].dataset.name;
  if (!sid || supplierIds.has(sid)) { this.value = ''; return; }
  supplierIds.add(sid);
  this.value = '';

  // Add hidden input
  var inp = document.createElement('input');
  inp.type = 'hidden'; inp.name = 'supplier_ids[]'; inp.value = sid; inp.id = 'sinp-' + sid;
  document.getElementById('supplierInputs').appendChild(inp);

  // Add chip
  var chip = document.createElement('span');
  chip.className = 'sup-chip'; chip.id = 'schip-' + sid;
  chip.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-truck"></i>' + name +
    '<button type="button" onclick="removeSupplier(' + sid + ')">&times;</button>';
  document.getElementById('selectedSuppliers').appendChild(chip);
});

function removeSupplier(sid) {
  supplierIds.delete(sid);
  var chip = document.getElementById('schip-' + sid);
  var inp  = document.getElementById('sinp-' + sid);
  if (chip) chip.remove();
  if (inp)  inp.remove();
}

updateCount();
</script>

<script>
var _locale  = '<%= locale %>';
var usedIds  = new Set();
var itemIdx  = 0;

function updateCount() {
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#itemsContainer .item-row');
  document.getElementById('itemCount').textContent = rows.length;
  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = rows.length ? 'none' : '';
}

function removeItem(idx, pid) {
  var row = document.getElementById('irow-' + idx);
  if (row) row.remove();
  usedIds.delete(pid);
  var opt = document.querySelector('#addProductSel option[value="' + pid + '"]');
  if (opt) opt.hidden = false;
  updateCount();
}

document.getElementById('addItemBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var sel  = document.getElementById('addProductSel');
  var pid  = parseInt(sel.value);
  if (!pid || usedIds.has(pid)) return;
  var opt   = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
  var name  = opt.dataset.name;
  var code  = opt.dataset.code;
  var unit  = opt.dataset.unit;
  var stock = parseInt(opt.dataset.stock) || 0;
  var qty   = parseInt(document.getElementById('addQty').value) || 1;
  var idx   = itemIdx++;

  var html =
    '<div class="item-row" id="irow-' + idx + '">' +
      '<input type="hidden" name="items[' + idx + '][product_id]" value="' + pid + '">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;min-width:160px;">' +
        '<div class="fw-bold" style="font-size:.82rem;">' + name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:.70rem;"><code>' + code + '</code> &bull; ' + unit + '</div>' +
        '<div class="stock-count">' + (_locale==='fr'?'Stock: ':'Stock: ') + stock + ' ' + unit + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="width:130px;">' +
        '<div class="lbl">' + (_locale==='fr'?'Qté demandée':'Qty Requested') + '</div>' +
        '<input type="number" name="items[' + idx + '][quantity_requested]" class="form-control form-control-sm" value="' + qty + '" min="1" max="' + stock + '" required>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger remove-btn" onclick="removeItem(' + idx + ',' + pid + ')">' +
        '<i class="fas fa-times"></i>' +
      '</button>' +
    '</div>';

  var empty = document.getElementById('emptyMsg');
  if (empty) empty.style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('itemsContainer').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
  usedIds.add(pid);
  opt.hidden = true;
  sel.value  = '';
  document.getElementById('addQty').value = 1;
  updateCount();
});

updateCount();
</script>
